description: This Java source file implements the <call-class-method> element used in the MiniLang framework for invoking class methods dynamically. It defines the CallClassMethod class, which encapsulates the logic to call specified static methods with parameters within the mini language execution context.

classes.name: CallClassMethod
classes.description: Represents a MiniLang element for invoking a static class method with specified parameters. It handles method invocation, parameter processing, and result storage.

classes.name: CallClassMethod.Factory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of CallClassMethod from XML elements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the call to the specified class method using reflection within the given method context.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the CallClassMethod instance, including class name, method name, and return field.
